mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline >0.25pp over 3 months, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE >5.5% for two months, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in housing starts indicates strengthening supply chain and construction activity that boosts corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO decline and HOUST rise, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit growth (RSAFS) exceeds 360,000 million dollars, it signals high credit expansion that triggers monetary tightening and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with RSAFS >360000, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS increase >0.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating price pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0%, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening demand environment that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with GDPC1 decline and HOUST rise, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 115.0, it signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO <115.0, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
